The vendor directly providing **Basecamp** at **basecamp.com** is **37signals LLC**.

### Supporting Evidence & Citation
According to the official **Terms of Service** governing `basecamp.com`:
> *“‘Company’, ‘we’, ‘our’, or ‘us’ in any of our policies or terms, refers to **37signals LLC**. ‘Services’ refers to our websites, including basecamp.com, hey.com, and 37signals.com, and any product created and maintained by 37signals LLC. That includes Basecamp (all versions)...”*

Additionally, the company's "Where we came from" page on `basecamp.com` states:
> *“I've been running 37signals — the business that makes Basecamp...”*
